question: 在A03同宽度LN/noLN配对中，hidden表示Gram谱条件数变化是否与offset-centered chord收益同向并解释其大小？
normalization: train target centered and standardized once; same transform applied to test
primary_measure: test centered residual variance chord = [E(-3)+E(+3)]/2-E(0), where E is residual variance after subtracting its sample mean

mediator.representation: last hidden activation before scalar head on train set

predictions.prediction: For each function and mean, LN final log10 condition number is lower than noLN in at least 3/5 paired seeds
Across 8 function-by-seed pairs, LN-minus-noLN chord is negatively correlated with LN-minus-noLN final log10 condition number (Pearson r <= -0.5)
A decrease in log10 condition number from step 0 to 256 accompanies a negative chord contribution in at least 6/8 functions

pairing: Same function, offset, seed and width; seeds assess paired variability, not new functions
boundaries: development only; no sealed OOD claim
condition number uses fixed 1e-12 eigenvalue floor
correlation is associational and does not prove mediation
no gradient alignment or curvature intervention
